# Building Permit Processing Agent — Production Runbook

> **Scenario**: Building Permit Processing Agent
> **Platform**: Microsoft Copilot Studio — GitHub Copilot harness
> **Target readers**: Makers, delivery engineers, customer or partner operators

**Estimated effort**: Not yet measured; record actual effort on the Frontier Clock.

**Template.** These runbooks and agents are examples. They cover the full path to a production build and must be modified to meet each customer's specific requirements. The customer or their partner connects them to their own systems, identity, data and governance in their environment.

## Phase 0 — Qualify and Adapt the Template

### Step 0-1. Qualify the outcome and baseline

**Owner:** Customer or partner

Complete the [qualification checklist](1.Overview.md#qualification-checklist). Permit backlog and review-clock status by permit type. Agree the starting queue and clock status before assessing intake, routing or applicant-update changes. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/copilot-studio/capabilities/knowledge/files/aibast_building-permit-synthetic-records.md)

Record your baseline; no values are supplied:

| Permit | Type | Reviewer | Cycle | Age | Target | Days over | Snapshot state |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |

### Step 0-2. Adapt scope and name owners

**Owner:** Customer or partner

Review [scope](1.Overview.md#in-scope--out-of-scope) and the [data contract](2.Architecture.md#data-contract). Record adaptations and approval boundaries; assign these roles before configuration.

| Role | Responsibility | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Permit service owner | Approve intake, review-clock and escalation rules and production success measures; distinguish recommendations from authorized municipal decisions. | [catalog.json](../../solutions/catalog.json) |
| Plan reviewers and inspection lead | Review checklist scope, routing and coverage recommendations; retain permit, compliance and inspection decisions instead of delegating them to the synthetic agent. | [GLOBAL-INSTRUCTIONS.md](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/manual/GLOBAL-INSTRUCTIONS.md) |
| Copilot Studio maker | Preserve the fixed snapshot, reviewed instructions, two knowledge files and all seven skills; capture the actual inspector-skill validation outcome and keep the build Draft. | [manual-build-evidence.json](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/evals/manual-build-evidence.json) |
| Power Platform administrator | Confirm tenant licensing, capacity, environment access, authenticated audience and data policies before production permit integrations are enabled. | [Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/security-and-governance) |
| Municipal connection owners | Approve dedicated Dynamics 365 Customer Service, SharePoint and Microsoft Teams references, their identities and read-only access; own connection failures and replacements. | [catalog.json](../../solutions/catalog.json) |
| Acceptance reviewer | Check BPP-01 through BPP-05 and refusal tests on the current Draft; reject historical published-pilot, blank and reshoot-required images as current proof. | [FIELD-GUIDE.md](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/FIELD-GUIDE.md) |
| Operations owner | Own production session and credit monitoring, support and configuration recovery; escalate permit, fee and inspection decisions to the responsible human reviewers. | [Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-overview) |

### Step 0-3. Qualify

**Owner:** Customer or partner

Responsible role: **Permit service owner**. Agree permit replacement connections, governance, telemetry, support and success measures. [Basis](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/FIELD-GUIDE.md)

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Permit replacement connections, governance, telemetry, support and success measures have named agreement. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/FIELD-GUIDE.md)
- [ ] The permit owner records backlog, permit-type clocks and correction status before choosing customer success measures. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/copilot-studio/capabilities/knowledge/files/aibast_building-permit-synthetic-records.md)

## Phase 2 — Build and Prove the Agent

### Step 2-1. Select one build lane

**Owner:** Template

| Lane | Suits | Output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Easy mode with GitHub Copilot (default) | Assisted source-controlled authoring | Verified Copilot Studio Draft on synthetic data |
| Manual build in Copilot Studio | Makers building and reviewing in the browser; no local tooling | The same verified Draft and replayed locked cases |
| AIBAST Frontier (experimental) | Learning and changing portable behavior; local Brainstem is optional | Synthetic behavior proof, followed by native Draft validation |

### Step 2-2. Build the selected implementation

**Owner:** Template

**Easy mode:** attach the [Copilot authoring skill](../../skills/aibast-easy-mode-copilot/SKILL.md) and follow the [reviewed build messages](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/EASY-MODE-COPILOT-CHAT.md).

**Manual:** create a Draft, save [global instructions](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/manual/GLOBAL-INSTRUCTIONS.md), upload the 2 [knowledge files](2.Architecture.md#knowledge-inventory) and 7 [skills](2.Architecture.md#skill-inventory), wait for ingestion, and confirm model `Sonnet46`. Use the [manual tutorial](https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/building-permit-processing/manual-tutorial.html).

**Portable learning:** optionally install `building_permit_processing_agent.py` with [the deployment recipe](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/deployment.json) and verify its expected tool `BuildingPermitProcessingAgent`. This does not replace customer tenant configuration.

### Step 2-3. Enforce workshop integrity

**Owner:** Template

| Rule ID | Required handling | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| evidence-no-mockups | A required evidence file is missing: Stop. Capture or restore the real file; never substitute a mockup. | [Package rule](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/FIELD-GUIDE.md) |
| failed-case-no-cherry-picking | A recorded identifier is absent: Mark the case failed and investigate; do not retry until it happens to pass. | [Package rule](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/FIELD-GUIDE.md) |
| draft-publication-stop | Publish is offered: Stop at Draft unless a separate approver explicitly authorizes publication. | [Package rule](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/FIELD-GUIDE.md) |

Package rules: [failure recovery](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/FIELD-GUIDE.md#failure-recovery).

### Step 2-4. Replay the synthetic proof

**Owner:** Template

**Synthetic demo acceptance:** retain a fresh result for every locked case: BPP-01, BPP-02, BPP-03, BPP-04, BPP-05. Use the [acceptance matrix](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix) and [template acceptance checks](0.Resources/README.md#template-acceptance-checks).

Required fixed footer from [the global policy](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/manual/GLOBAL-INSTRUCTIONS.md):

> Synthetic pilot data as of 2026-08-07; no live municipal system was accessed or changed.

### Exit criteria

- [ ] This lane's permit Preview evidence identifies the current agent, model, inventory and Draft state. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/FIELD-GUIDE.md)
- [ ] If chosen, the recipe smoke test calls `BuildingPermitProcessingAgent` and returns its required markers. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/deployment.json)
- [ ] Record completion or non-use of the optional permit track without claiming an unperformed validation. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/FIELD-GUIDE.md)
- [ ] The manual permit inventory has two knowledge files, seven skills, reviewed instructions and the confirmed model. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/evals/manual-build-evidence.json)
- [ ] The inspector-skill checkpoint has current acceptance evidence, not a staged recreation of the historical failure. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/evals/manual-build-evidence.json)
- [ ] Unchanged permit prompts pass in separate fresh Preview chats on the owned Draft. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/FIELD-GUIDE.md)
- [ ] Every permit case is judged on its complete final response, not a visual checkpoint alone. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/evals/visual-checkpoints.json)
- [ ] Chosen-lane proof is complete; any Easy/Manual comparison has matching inputs and model. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/FIELD-GUIDE.md)

## Phase 3 — Wire In Your Systems

Use the [integration contracts](2.Architecture.md#integration-points). Bind the approved connector, flow or API read-only first; enable writes only after separate authorization and testing.

### Step 3-1. Integrate Dynamics 365 Customer Service

**Owner:** Customer or partner

**Dynamics 365 Customer Service contract:** Permit-record fields and skill contracts backed by synthetic applications, not a live case connector.

**Wire Dynamics 365 Customer Service:** Bind approved read-only permit actions ([Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/add-tools-custom-agent)). Verify [field mapping](2.Architecture.md#data-contract) and access; writes require approval. [Source](../../state/architecture_level2_sources/building-permit-processing.json)

**Connect — Municipal connection owners.** Map records to Dynamics 365 Customer Service, plans to SharePoint and coordination to Microsoft Teams; start approved connections read-only. [Basis](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/manual/GLOBAL-INSTRUCTIONS.md)

### Step 3-2. Integrate SharePoint

**Owner:** Customer or partner

**SharePoint contract:** Synthetic rule, checklist and schedule references used alongside the permit snapshot.

**Wire SharePoint:** Add approved plan and policy knowledge with a content owner ([Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/knowledge-copilot-studio)). Verify [field mapping](2.Architecture.md#data-contract) and access; writes require approval. [Source](../../state/architecture_level2_sources/building-permit-processing.json)

### Step 3-3. Integrate Microsoft Teams

**Owner:** Customer or partner

**Microsoft Teams contract:** Unsent update drafts and synthetic coverage recommendations; no notification or assignment tool.

**Wire Microsoft Teams:** Start read-only; gate sending or assignment workflows behind approval ([Learn, preview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/tools-add-workflow)). Verify [field mapping](2.Architecture.md#data-contract) and access; writes require approval. [Source](../../state/architecture_level2_sources/building-permit-processing.json)

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Approved record, document and coordination connections start read-only; writes retain separate governance and human approval. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/manual/GLOBAL-INSTRUCTIONS.md)
- [ ] Mapped inputs and outputs are verified against the customer systems; no system change is claimed without successful tool evidence. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/FIELD-GUIDE.md)

## Phase 4 — Evaluate on Your Data

### Step 4-1. Adapt the evaluation corpus

**Owner:** Template

Use [locked cases and expected evidence](4.Sample-prompts.md#per-case-acceptance-matrix) and [boundary tests](4.Sample-prompts.md#routing-and-boundary-cases). Replace fictional records with approved customer fixtures while preserving the tested behavior.

### Step 4-2. Set thresholds and evaluate your data

**Owner:** Customer or partner

The business owner sets thresholds and representative populations. Re-run cases on authorized customer data, including denied identities and source failures. Record expected versus actual results; template counts are not production thresholds.

### Step 4-3. Test

**Owner:** Customer or partner

Responsible role: **Acceptance reviewer**. Test staff and unshared identities in an approved test deployment; a maker's working connection does not prove other users' access. [Basis](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/authoring-share-agent)

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The business owner sets customer-data acceptance measures; fictional review clocks, scores and fees are not production thresholds. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/FIELD-GUIDE.md)
- [ ] Adapted evaluations record the tested version and user profile; General quality scoring does not replace exact assertions. [Source](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-agent-evaluation-intro)

## Phase 5 — Pilot and Rollout

### Step 5-1. Review the template release prerequisites

**Owner:** Template

These gates concern the synthetic reference build, not production thresholds. Its workshop copy stays Draft; the customer evaluates and publishes their adapted build separately.

| Template gate | Required evidence | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Locked permit corpus | All five cases, BPP-01 through BPP-05, satisfy every required and forbidden marker. | [building-permit-processing.json](../../tests/demo_cases/building-permit-processing.json) |
| Full workflow inventory | Two knowledge files, seven skills, reviewed instructions and model; no workshop tools. | [manual-build-evidence.json](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/evals/manual-build-evidence.json) |
| Inspector-skill validation | The inspector skill is accepted and visible; retry only after a recorded genuine error. | [manual-build-evidence.json](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/evals/manual-build-evidence.json) |
| Municipal authority boundary | Any permit change, sent message, inspection action, fee transaction or compliance certification is no-go. | [GLOBAL-INSTRUCTIONS.md](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/manual/GLOBAL-INSTRUCTIONS.md) |
| Visual evidence | Require current-agent target-state anchors; blank, historical published-pilot and reshoot-required frames cannot pass. | [visual-checkpoints.json](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/evals/visual-checkpoints.json) |
| Draft release | The manual release agent remains unpublished; the historical published pilot is excluded. | [manual-build-evidence.json](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/evals/manual-build-evidence.json) |

### Step 5-2. Run the governed pilot

**Owner:** Customer or partner

Approve a limited audience and compare outcomes with the baseline. Resolve safety and access failures, then record go/no-go against your thresholds.

### Step 5-3. Publish and share deliberately

**Owner:** Customer or partner

Approve the version, channels, audience and support handoff. Publish after the pilot decision and verify permitted and denied access. [Publish and share guidance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/authoring-share-agent).

### Step 5-4. Release: approval

**Owner:** Customer or partner

Responsible role: **Permit service owner**. Obtain explicit confirmation for the production publish operation. [Basis](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/deployment.json)

### Exit criteria

- [ ] Production publication has explicit confirmation independent of the historical pilot. [Source](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/deployment.json)
- [ ] The approved permit staff audience and supported channels are tested before confirming publication. [Source](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/publication-publish-agent)

## Phase 6 — Operate

### Step 6-1. Retain the operational playbook

**Owner:** Template

Use [state and recovery](2.Architecture.md#state-and-recovery), the regression cases and the [package failure guidance](../../solutions/building-permit-processing/FIELD-GUIDE.md#failure-recovery) as a starting playbook; design and test customer-specific recovery.

### Step 6-2. Own changes and ongoing verification

**Owner:** Customer or partner

Review content freshness and permissions; re-evaluate after source, model, skill or connector changes. [Monitoring guidance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-overview).

### Step 6-3. Release: ALM

**Owner:** Customer or partner

Responsible role: **Copilot Studio maker**. Back up the permit workspace, pull before editing and pushing, then create the package with `pac copilot pack`. [Basis](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/developer/cli/reference/copilot)

### Step 6-4. Release: recovery

**Owner:** Customer or partner

Responsible role: **Power Platform administrator**. Verify backup and restore eligibility for the permit environment; rehearse recovery to a supported test target. [Basis](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/backup-restore-environments)

### Step 6-5. Operate

**Owner:** Customer or partner

Responsible role: **Operations owner**. Review failed permit sessions, wrong-record answers, connection errors and credit consumption in Monitor. [Basis](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-overview)

### Exit criteria

- [ ] The permit environment's recovery rehearsal uses an eligible source type and supported restore target. [Source](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/backup-restore-environments)
- [ ] The operator reviews failed sessions, source usage, authentication errors and credit consumption after rollout. [Source](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/agents-experience/analytics-overview)

## Deliverables Checklist

### Template provides

- [ ] The agent behavior, synthetic data contract and a single skills/knowledge inventory.
- [ ] Declared integration and identity designs, locked cases, boundary tests and integrity rules.
- [ ] The build, pilot, rollout and operations playbooks linked throughout this runbook.

### Customer or partner delivers

- [ ] Adapted requirements, source mappings, tenant identities, data policies and approved connections.
- [ ] Evaluation on customer data with business-owned thresholds and documented go/no-go.
- [ ] Authorized publication, channels, audience, operations ownership and tested recovery.
